message.content: Halo! Sepertinya ukuran XS memang belum tersedia untuk produk yang Anda maksud. Bisa tolong beri tahu nama atau kode produk yang Anda cari? Dengan begitu saya bisa cek ketersediaan ukuran lain atau memberi tahu kapan ukuran XS akan kembali stok. Terima kasih!
message.reasoning: The user says in Indonesian: "Hallo, ukuran XS tidak ada ya?" Means: "Hello, is there no size XS?" They likely want to know if size XS is available. We need to respond. There's no mention of a specific product or store. We might ask clarifying question or provide general answer. We could say: "Maaf, ukuran XS tidak tersedia saat ini. Apakah Anda ingin melihat ukuran lain?" Or ask for product. We can also mention that we can check inventory. But we don't have inventory data. We can ask for product name. So respond politely.
